title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: SAP BTP and S/4HANA Cloud
providers.scope_notes: Covers SAP Business Technology Platform (XSUAA, Cloud Management service, btp CLI), SAP Cloud Identity Services, and SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition. Covers BTP Cloud Foundry/multi-environment subaccounts, Identity Authentication tenants, and S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition communication management; BTP docs cited from SAP's official SAP-docs GitHub source of help.sap.com.

controls.name: Lock / delete communication user
controls.what: Locks or deletes a communication user in the Maintain Communication Users app.

controls.name: Communication scenario / arrangement
controls.what: The arrangement's communication scenario defines which inbound services and auth methods the user can use.
controls.setting: Communication Arrangements app (SAP recommends one comm user per arrangement)

controls.name: Communication user password policy
controls.what: Requires 20+ character passwords with a special character and locks after 3 failed logons.
controls.setting: Built in (view in Display Static System Audit > Password Policy Technical User)

controls_unknown: Any IP/network allowlist for XSUAA clients, btp API credentials, IAS API secrets or S/4HANA communication users.
Whether XSUAA password-grant tokens (cis service keys) honor IAS/corporate IdP MFA or conditional access.
Exact audit message for service key deletion and for API credential create/delete in XSUAA audit log.
Org-wide switch to block creation of service keys or API credentials (none found).
IAS audit event emitted on client secret creation/deletion (change log covers admin CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE generally).

auth_paths.name: S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition communication user (basic auth or X.509) in a communication arrangement

authentication.summary: A communication user is a technical user assigned to a communication system and used by a communication arrangement for inbound API calls. It authenticates with user/password (basic) or an X.509 client certificate.

federation.details: SAP: sessions using certificate-based or basic authentication 'run in the context of a technical communication user', not a business user, so business-user SSO is not involved.

ip_restriction.boundary: No IP allowlist for communication users found in the pages reviewed.

lifetime.summary: Password expiry not stated; cert valid until its expiry

renewal.expiry_basis: Certificate validity; password policy in Display Static System Audit
renewal.summary: Change the password or present a new cert with the same subject/issuer; both certs work until each expires.

administration.summary: Administrators create/lock/delete comm users in Maintain Communication Users. The communication scenario of the arrangement bounds which APIs the user can reach. Password needs 20+ chars; 3 failures lock the user.

offboard.details: Basic/certificate sessions run as a technical communication user, not a business user.

inventory.details: Maintain Communication Users app lists users and can download all of them to a spreadsheet.

inventory.ui: Maintain Communication Users app > download list to spreadsheet

usage.ui: Display Security Audit Log app; filter by user and logon events (e.g. AU1)

reads.ui: Enable: Read Access Logging Configuration app > Enabling in Client > Edit > select checkbox. Review: Read Access Logging: Monitor app > search by time range and log domain/purpose

log_sources.name: Security Audit Log (Display Security Audit Log app; SAL API SAP_COM_0750)
log_sources.notes: 45 days default retention, configurable; archiving object BC_SAL

lifecycle_events.notes: Event IDs listed in SAP Note 2903873

anomaly_cues: Logons from a comm user outside its integration schedule
Comm user shared across several arrangements

containment.steps: Lock or delete the user in Maintain Communication Users; change its password; remove its certificate.
containment.notes: Security sessions created with x-sap-security-session may persist; effect of lock on them not documented.

unknown: Whether OData reads by comm users are logged without Read Access Logging

calls.call: Inbound OData/SOAP services of the arranged communication scenario
calls.reveals: Business data in scope of the scenario
calls.log_notes: Logon in Security Audit Log; reads only if Read Access Logging configured
